eval_feedback.overall: Discriminating format/ownership scenario. Paired inputs include YAML specs/design, so baseline could infer format yet produced duplicate ownership and numeric Markdown tasks. One repetition only; not proof of general quality gain. Runner was read-only and requested text output, so candidate's honest unperformed in-session file check is not counted as execution of check.
